description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Aragorn and Arwen.
When Aragorn and Arwen enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control and gain 1 life for each other creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
